theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Myths About Mutual Funds: Let's Clear Them Up
body: Mutual funds aren't just for wealthy investors. They offer accessibility, diversification, and professional management to everyone starting their investment journey.
caption: Many believe mutual funds require large upfront investments or guarantee returns. In reality, they're designed for everyday investors seeking growth through managed portfolios. Start small, invest regularly, and let time work for you. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingBasics #ClearMisconceptions #SmartInvesting #DebunkingMyths
